set.body:
Make the shell host-neutral so web (Laminar), Electron, hosted desktop or JavaFX hosts share one controller and compiler (user request 2026-09-22).
Scope: (1) ADR 0001 host-neutral shell; (2) extract a cross-built 'shell' module (JVM+JS) from app: ViewChoice/Playhead, SemanticZoom + intent gate, InteractionDecoration/RenderedTargetIndex, interaction presentation, AppCompiler producing renderer-neutral plates (intaglio Scene + box + title) instead of SVG strings; (3) host-neutral activation/selection transitions and per-name presentation in shell; web host keeps DOM hit-testing behind that seam.
Out of scope while bd-01M35KH000EKPC7DZSCY988TKQ holds VoyageLowering/VoyageView: Voyage extraction (follow-up). Upstream: intaglio has no public picking over a hand-built named Scene (Picking.compile needs a Plot InteractionPlan); file in intaglio, no pin bump until used.
Acceptance: shell suites pass on JVM and JS; compileAll testAll scalafmtCheckAll app/fastLinkJS; edition bundle + browser smoke; static edition bytes unchanged.
set.title: [Shell] Extract a host-neutral shell core for web/desktop hosts
